# stacky

> stacky is a self-hosted, compose-first Docker stack manager for home labs. It is a web UI over plain `compose.yaml` directories (Dockge-compatible), with live logs and stats, image update checks, git-backed stacks, notifications, self-update, a token-authenticated REST API and a built-in MCP server for AI agents. It ships as one multi-arch Docker image (`ghcr.io/patsissons/stacky`).

Key facts:

- Each stack is a directory `<STACKY_STACKS_DIR>/<name>/` (default `/opt/stacks`) holding `compose.yaml` and an optional `.env`. The files on disk are the source of truth; stacky never re-serializes them.
- Every `docker compose` run is an operation (`queued → running → succeeded | failed | cancelled`), one at a time per stack. Failures are classified into a code, a message and a hint.
- Integrations authenticate with API tokens (`Authorization: Bearer stk_…`): the REST API under `/api` (OpenAPI 3.1 at `/api/openapi.json`) and the MCP server at `/api/mcp` (stateless Streamable HTTP).
- This repository is a pnpm monorepo in TypeScript. Contributor rules live in `AGENTS.md`.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index (llms.txt)](https://stacky.lgtm.page/llms.txt): the docs site's own index for LLMs
- [Complete documentation](https://stacky.lgtm.page/llms-full.txt): every docs page in one file
- [Install](https://stacky.lgtm.page/getting-started/install/): one-line installer, manual compose setup
- [Using stacky](https://stacky.lgtm.page/guides/using-stacky/): stacks, editor, containers, logs, shells
- [Configuration](https://stacky.lgtm.page/reference/configuration/): every environment variable (`STACKY_*`, `DOCKER_HOST`, `TZ`…)
- [Labels](https://stacky.lgtm.page/reference/labels/): every compose label stacky reads (`stacky.display.icon`, `stacky.update.schedule`, `stacky.notify`…) and `x-stacky.urls`
- [How it works](https://stacky.lgtm.page/how-it-works/overview/): architecture and the operation model
- [Errors](https://stacky.lgtm.page/how-it-works/errors/): how compose failures become actionable errors

## Integrations

- [AI agents & MCP](https://stacky.lgtm.page/guides/agents/): connect Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and others to `/api/mcp`; tool list
- [REST API](https://stacky.lgtm.page/reference/api/): authentication, operations, recipes and error shape
- [Sign-in and security](https://stacky.lgtm.page/guides/authentication/): API tokens, 2FA, OIDC and the activity log

## Source

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/patsissons/stacky/blob/main/AGENTS.md): working rules for contributors and coding agents (tests, docs, `pnpm format-and-validate`)
- [apps/server](https://github.com/patsissons/stacky/tree/main/apps/server): Hono API + WebSocket server; REST routes in `src/api/routes.ts`, OpenAPI in `src/api/openapi.ts`, MCP tools in `src/mcp/tools.ts`, operations in `src/ops/engine.ts`
- [apps/web](https://github.com/patsissons/stacky/tree/main/apps/web): React UI (Vite, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, TanStack Router/Query); Playwright e2e in `e2e/`
- [apps/site](https://github.com/patsissons/stacky/tree/main/apps/site): docs site (Astro Starlight) deployed to https://stacky.lgtm.page; pages in `src/content/docs/`
- [packages/shared](https://github.com/patsissons/stacky/tree/main/packages/shared): zod schemas and types shared by server and web
- [docker](https://github.com/patsissons/stacky/tree/main/docker): production Dockerfile and example compose file

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://github.com/patsissons/stacky/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release notes, generated by release-please from Conventional Commits
- [Migrating from Dockge](https://stacky.lgtm.page/getting-started/migrating-from-dockge/): point stacky at an existing Dockge stacks directory
- [Image updates](https://stacky.lgtm.page/guides/image-updates/): registry checks, What's Up Docker, applying updates
- [Updating stacky itself](https://stacky.lgtm.page/guides/self-update/): self-update with automatic rollback
